items.name: session
items.title: Session bindings
items.description: One authenticated transport, typed client, TanStack Query client and live invalidation bindings for the local authority.

items.name: native-dialog
items.title: Native dialog
items.description: Modal on the native <dialog> element: focus trap, Escape and inert background without injected <style> tags, so it works under a strict CSP.

items.name: capability-form
items.title: Capability form
items.description: A complete form for any command capability, generated from its JSON Schema, with contract validation, a per-form idempotency key and field-level server errors.

items.name: live-data-table
items.title: Live data table
items.description: TanStack Table over a server-scoped, server-paginated capability query; never filters or counts client-side.

items.name: security-screen
items.title: Security screen
items.description: Read-only security posture for auditors: bound, disabled and used destinations, recent denials and audit-chain status, from the assurance.* queries. Polls; each read is itself audited.

items.name: conflict-banner
items.title: Conflict banner
items.description: Shown when committed data moved past a draft's base revision; rebase or discard, never overwrite.

items.name: run-panel
items.title: Agent run panel
items.description: Recent agent runs with inline answers to questions and approvals.

items.name: command-palette
items.title: Capability palette
items.description: ⌘K palette over the discovered contract: the human mirror of an agent's tool list.

items.name: screens
items.title: Application screens contract
items.description: The declaration an application hands the frame: routes, navigation, the screen each capability family opens, and a sidebar status slot.

items.name: ui-session
items.title: UI session
items.description: Registers the screen's selection with the authority so an agent run captures what the person sees, and receives intents the agent sends back.

items.name: accounts
items.title: Provider accounts
items.description: Connects agent provider accounts through the authority; the browser only ever sees safe metadata.

items.name: app-shell
items.title: App shell
items.description: Sidebar with the application's title, context, a section slot, navigation with count badges and a status slot, and the capability palette (⌘K). Exports NavigationCount, SidebarSection and SidebarLink.

items.name: frame
items.title: Application frame
items.description: Session-scoped query cache, live invalidation and hash routing around an application's screens, plus the launch-link exchange.
